properties.name: Makah Indian Reservation
properties.policy: Preserve the historical Olympic coverage decision to exclude unreviewed tribal approaches: subtract the retained, previously reviewed Olympic footprint from this reservation polygon. This is a conservative product scope, not a claim that all tribal land is closed or that a permit cannot authorize recreation. The OSM polygon is mapping evidence, not a surveyed legal boundary.
properties.derivation: Pinned reservation polygon minus data/regions/olympic-peninsula/boundary.geojson; no smoothing or coordinate rounding.
